name: dmlab/module-typesense-instant-search
description: Storefront instant, typo-tolerant search-as-you-type for Magento 2. Replaces the stock autocomplete in place via a RequireJS map override — no Hyvä/Alpine/React dependency, works on stock Luma. Proxy mode keeps Typesense private (default); direct mode queries it from the browser with a derived scoped search-only key. Free and uncapped.
